name: Leo Oneshot
source:
It's been a few years after the events of [url=/v18157]Echo[/url]. Leo's in a better place, he knows you after all! The two of you have been talking and sometimes visiting, teetering on the edge of just friends with benefits and something more. When you go to visit Leo for a third time, you expect it to be a quick fun trip. Leo has other plans though. As usual.

[From [url=https://hobbess.itch.io/leo-oneshot]Itch.io[/url]]
